note: The only place site boxes live. Every notebook reads its site from here, chosen by the DUNESIGHT_SITE environment variable (default seih_al_hama). Only sites with verified=true are run by `npm run pipeline` and get data in public/data/<site_id>/. Boxes are WGS84 (EPSG:4326) degrees; `epsg` is the projected CRS used for processing.

sites.name: Seih Al Hama, SW of Al Ain
sites.note: AOI-1 from the Phase 1 research: about 10.2 km E-W x 9.95 km N-S, centroid 24.060 N, 55.525 E, containing the 'Sieh Al Hama Camel Race Track' (24.0578614, 55.5217188), the E40 road, a settlement and plantations. EPSG:32640 and WRS-2 160/043 confirmed from USGS STAC footprints. CAVEAT: the link between this place name and the Fareaa (2025, UAEU) thesis study area is NOT confirmed. The thesis full text and study-area map were not reachable, its Arabic abstract spells the field 'Seih Al-Lahma', and GeoNames has a different 'Sayh al Hammah' trough 13 km WSW (AOI-2 in the research note). The box was chosen for dunes next to roads and farms, not because it is proven to be the thesis site.

sites.name: Sweihan dune field, NW of Al Ain
sites.note: Not located yet (Phase 1b). No box, CRS or path/row until they are verified from sources; do not run the pipeline for this site.

sites.name: Liwa, southern Abu Dhabi
sites.note: Not located yet (Phase 1b). Megadunes here are expected to move below the detection limit (about 0.1 m/yr from a field estimate, Lorenz & Radebaugh 2015); if so the app must say exactly that. Do not run the pipeline for this site until the box is verified.
